source: State rates: state DOR statutes (2025-26). Average local rates: computed by paysums (tools/localavg.py) as the population-weighted average of the local rates in each state's official rate tables, Census SUB-EST2024 weights; per-state sources in data/localavg.json. City combined rates: city/county DOR published combined rates. Re-verified city by city on 12 Oct 2026 against each state's own publication for the quarter beginning 1 October 2026, which found two rates that had been carried forward from before 2025. Denver 8.81% -> 9.15%: the Denver sales tax rate is 5.15%, not 4.81% (City and County of Denver Tax Guide Topic No. 70, 2026 edition, and the Denver Combined Tax Rates sheet effective 1-1-2025, which prints 5.15% Denver + 2.90% State + 1.00% RTD + 0.10% Cultural Facilities District = 9.15%). Nashville 9.25% -> 9.75%: Davidson County's local option rate is 2.75%, not 2.25%, after the 0.5% transit surcharge approved on 5 Nov 2024 took effect on 1 Feb 2025 (Tennessee DOR Sales and Use Tax Notice #24-11), on top of the 7.00% state rate. Unchanged on their 1 October 2026 publications: Los Angeles 10.25% (the city levies no district tax of its own, so it takes the new Los Angeles County rate - CDTFA L-1037 and CDTFA-95 rev. 39 (10-26)), San Francisco 8.625%, San Diego 7.75%, San Jose 10.00%, Sacramento 8.75% (same CDTFA-95); Seattle 10.55% (WA DOR Q4 2026 flyer); Phoenix 9.10% (ADOR rate table effective 1 Oct 2026: Maricopa 6.30% + Phoenix 2.80%); Kansas City 8.975% and St Louis 9.679% (MO DOR October-December 2026 table); Salt Lake City 8.45% (Utah Tax Commission 26Q4 combined chart); Minneapolis 9.025% (MN DOR rate guide effective 10/1/2026); Atlanta 8.9% (Georgia DOR general rate chart effective 1 Oct 2026); Charlotte 8.25% and Raleigh 7.25% (NCDOR; Mecklenburg's extra 1% took effect 1 Jul 2026); Columbus and Cleveland 8.00% (Ohio Dept of Taxation Q4 2026 by-county table - only Warren County changes on 1 Oct 2026); Houston, Dallas, Austin and San Antonio 8.25% (Texas Comptroller current rate file: each is at the 2% local cap); Jacksonville 7.5%, Tampa 7.5%, Miami 7.0%, Orlando 6.5% (Florida DR-15DSS for 2026); Las Vegas 8.375% (Nevada Dept of Taxation); New York City 8.875% (NYS Pub. 718-PPA); Honolulu 4.712% (Hawaii DoTax maximum pass-on rate). Washington DC stays at 6.0%: the increase to 7% that had been scheduled for 1 October 2026 is postponed, and OTR's sales and use tax FAQ now states that the general sales tax rate remains 6% through 30 September 2027. No state changed its statutory rate in 2026. 'lookup' = the state's official rate-by-address lookup page. 'lookup' = the state's official rate-by-address lookup page.
